question: Should core Skill Workshop permanently expose proposal review previews and bind pending approval decisions to the reviewed proposal version?
rationale: This is a new user-facing core tool and lifecycle contract, not a repair of an established behavior; tests and proof can validate the implementation but cannot decide whether this policy belongs in the core product.

options.title: Accept the bounded core contract
options.body: Keep the portable review action and version-bound pending approvals, then rebase and refresh exact-head validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer the feature
options.body: Keep the PR open only if maintainers want a smaller review surface or prefer to defer the new lifecycle contract until its API direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded core contract
recommendation.body: Keep the portable review action and version-bound pending approvals, then rebase and refresh exact-head validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent Skill Workshop approval-resolution boundary affected by the new version-binding behavior.
